name: LED bit-map diagnostic
description: Diagnostic only. Forces all 56 outputs on in the SPI output buffer 0x20001E74 immediately before the shift-out, every scan phase. If keys/segments light, the driver path is confirmed; if nothing lights, the buffer or hook is wrong. Flash alone (untick Polyphony v1.1). Not for musical use.

patches.note: force all key bits in the output buffer before SPI shift-out
